Name: PPJA - Cannabis Kit
Author: paradigmnomad
AuthorLabel: taintedwheat and Project Populate Json Assets
Description:
[left][img]https://i.imgur.com/1jSXqPK.png[/img]﻿

Mayor Lewis has recently passed legislation legalizing all aspects of cannabis! Now you can grow, use, and sell your very own weed. Adds a new crop as well as a handful of new recipes and (static) craftables. 

[b][url=https://www.indiegamewebsite.com/2019/07/15/top-7-indie-game-modding-communities/]Featured in IndieGameWebsite's Top Modding Communities[/url][/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LKwk9jp.png[/img]

- While functional, there are things I want to add to this mod in the future if I have time
- Due to the limitations of the SDV character sprite sheets, you eat the recipes rather than smoke
- Now includes [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/stardope-valley-adding-cannabis-as-a-mod-to-sdv-update-5-4.112815/]StarDOPE Valley[/url]﻿ with permission from taintedwheat

[size=1][img]https://i.imgur.com/cVevYNe.png[/img]

[/size]﻿See MouseyPounds database!
﻿
[url=https://mouseypounds.github.io/ppja-ref/index.html]L I N K[/url][url=https://mouseypounds.github.io/ppja-ref/index.html][/url]
﻿[/left][img]https://i.imgur.com/Eqdpuvd.png[/img]

- Latest vresion of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]

- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1926]Artisan Valley[/url] + dependencies (optional, for machines)

 [img]https://i.imgur.com/kLbxt2U.png[/img]﻿

Step 1. Install SMAPI, Json Assets, SpaceCore, Producer Framework Mod (optional), and Artisan Valley + its dependencies (optional).
Step 2. Download this mod and extract the zip file anywhere you would like. There are 2 files included in the download:

[JA] Cannabis Kit
[PFM] Cannabis Kit

Step 3. Drag & Drop the extracted folder(s) directly into the /Mods folder.

 [img]https://i.imgur.com/MnkF0nq.png[/img]﻿

Step 1. Remove every existing item (crop, clothing, seeds, etc.) excluding items in shops & letters.
Step 2. Remove the corresponding folders.

Forgetting to remove existing items (especially in your inventory) can crash your game.

Downloads.Description:
Bug fixes and removes a leftover folder.

Extract the files and drag + drop all (2) folders into `/Mods`. No longer needs a separate AV file.
Make sure to delete pre-existing folders. DO NOT SIMPLY OVERWRITE
